purpose: Citations inside data/research/ that point at files not present in this repository. Enforced by scripts/validation/research_evidence_paths_contract.js, which prints this list on every run and fails the build on any unresolved citation NOT listed here. An entry is an admission that a claim's evidence is currently unavailable - it is not an exemption from fixing it.
rules: Every entry needs a reason and a first_seen date.
An entry whose file has since been restored must be deleted; the contract fails on stale entries so this list cannot quietly accumulate.
Do not add an entry to make a build green. If a research claim's evidence is gone, the honest fix is usually to correct the claim, not to shelve the citation.
